summary: The tarball values file uses pluginMode tarball with the same imageRegistry, image and orgs settings; PostgreSQL image lines are only for the built-in DB. imageRegistry must be the host only (the chart appends ansible-automation-platform/automation-portal); use ociPluginImage for other paths. Install with helm install redhat-rhaap-portal <chart>.tgz --namespace ... -f values-oci.yaml.
